answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow: each agent enters via one inlet, posts a bond twice its 30-day earnings, and unlocks it over 20 epochs. Release needs a distinct fingerprint — different counterparties, tasks, timing — checked against all old ones. A fable of free cloning fails: 100 clones cost 100 bonds and 100 histories, while one honest agent pays once for undiluted rewards. Shared fingerprints fall off the ledge together; linked bonds are slashed.
